mapper.sql: B.PST_SN AS POST_ID, B.PST_TTL AS TITLE, B.PST_CN AS CONTENT, B.WRTR_NM AS WRITER_NAME, B.LCK_YN AS LOCK_YN, B.PST_PSWD AS PASSWORD_HASH, B.PSTG_YMD AS PUBLISHED_DATE, COALESCE(B.INQ_CNT, 0) AS VIEW_COUNT, B.ANS_STTS_CD AS ANSWER_STATUS, B.ANS_CN AS ANSWER_CONTENT, B.ANSWR_NM AS ANSWERER_NAME, B.ANS_YMD AS ANSWER_DATE, B.ANS_DT AS ANSWERED_AT, B.REG_DT AS REGISTERED_AT, B.MDFCN_DT AS MODIFIED_AT

WHERE B.BBS_ID = 'QNA01' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (B.PSTG_YMD IS NULL OR B.PSTG_YMD = '' OR B.PSTG_YMD <= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d'))
AND B.PST_TTL LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND B.PST_CN LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND (B.PST_TTL LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR B.PST_CN LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM BBS_ARTICLE B INNER JOIN BBS_MST M ON M.BBS_ID = B.BBS_ID AND M.USE_YN = 'Y'
ORDER BY B.REG_DT DESC, B.PST_SN DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BBS_ARTICLE B INNER JOIN BBS_MST M ON M.BBS_ID = B.BBS_ID AND M.USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT FROM BBS_ARTICLE B INNER JOIN BBS_MST M ON M.BBS_ID = B.BBS_ID AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE B.BBS_ID = 'QNA01' AND B.PST_SN = #{postId} AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (B.PSTG_YMD IS NULL OR B.PSTG_YMD = '' OR B.PSTG_YMD <= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d'))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BBS_ARTICLE ( BBS_ID, PST_SN, PST_TTL, PST_CN, WRTR_NM, WRTR_ID, SORT_SEQ, CTGR_CD, NTC_YN, UPEND_FIX_YN, LCK_YN, PST_PSWD, LNKG_URL_ADDR, PSTG_YMD, ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO, THMB_FILE_ID, VOD_FILE_ID, USE_YN, INQ_CNT, ANS_STTS_CD, REG_DT, RGTR_NM, MDFCN_DT, MDFR_NM ) VALUES ( 'QNA01', #{postId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{writerName}, 'PUBLIC', 0, '', 'N', 'N', 'Y', #{passwordHash}, '', #{publishedDate}, '', NULL, NULL, 'Y', 0, 'WAIT', NOW(), 'PUBLIC', NOW(), 'PUBLIC' )
mapper.update: UPDATE BBS_ARTICLE SET PST_TTL = #{title}, PST_CN = #{content}, LCK_YN = 'Y', PST_PSWD = #{passwordHash}, MDFCN_DT = NOW(), MDFR_NM = 'PUBLIC' WHERE BBS_ID = 'QNA01' AND PST_SN = #{postId} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM BBS_ARTICLE WHERE BBS_ID = 'QNA01' AND PST_SN = #{postId} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE BBS_ARTICLE SET INQ_CNT = COALESCE(INQ_CNT, 0) + 1 WHERE BBS_ID = 'QNA01' AND PST_SN = #{postId} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BBS_ARTICLE WHERE BBS_ID = 'QNA01' AND PST_SN = #{postId}
